title: Youngstown PD body cam, dash cam, Taser and reports: July 2, 2024 motorcycle pursuit and arrest of Eshaun Lambert

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Ohio Open Records Law, I hereby request the following records:

1. All body-worn camera and in-car camera recordings, with audio, made by Youngstown Police Department officers on July 2, 2024, from approximately 6:30 p.m. to 8:00 p.m., related to: the motorcyclist who performed a wheelie in front of officers on Hillman Street near St. Louis Avenue at approximately 6:39 p.m.; the pursuit to Himrod Avenue and through east side streets; the motorcycle riding through Mount Hope Veterans Memorial Cemetery, 1945 Liberty Road; the Taser deployment; and the arrest of Eshaun Lambert (then 31). I do not request any portion recorded inside a medical facility.
2. The incident/offense report, supplemental reports, arrest report, any use-of-force or Taser deployment report, and the Taser deployment log for this incident.
3. The CAD/call detail report and radio/dispatch audio for the incident, including communications with the Ohio State Highway Patrol aviation unit.
4. Photographs of the motorcycle, of the cemetery and any damaged headstones, and Mr. Lambert's booking photograph if held by your department.

This incident was reported by WFMJ (story 50986945). If my year is wrong, please search for a July 2 incident involving Mr. Lambert between 2023 and 2025. If any portion is withheld, please cite the specific exemption under R.C. 149.43 and release all remaining portions. Electronic delivery in original file format preferred. Please send an itemized cost estimate before processing if charges will exceed $40.

A note on the template sentence below about commercial purposes: I may use these records in an editorial, documentary-style video about this incident published on YouTube, which may earn advertising revenue. I am not requesting them for resale or to solicit anyone.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days.

Sincerely,

Matyáš Krmela

title: Texas DPS in-car, body cam and aircraft video, reports: Feb. 5, 2024 motorcycle pursuit and arrest of Matthew Lee Dennis, Bryan

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Texas Public Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

1. All in-car camera and body-worn camera recordings, with audio, made by Texas Department of Public Safety troopers on February 5, 2024, during the afternoon (approximately 2:00 p.m. to 6:30 p.m.), related to: the attempted stop of a motorcycle clocked at approximately 167 mph on State Highway 6 near Woodville Road in north Bryan, Brazos County; the pursuit on SH 6, FM 2818 (Harvey Mitchell Parkway) and Beck Street, including the motorcycle traveling into oncoming traffic toward school buses; the trooper's use of his patrol vehicle to push the motorcycle over at Harvey Mitchell Parkway and Beck Street; the foot pursuit; and the arrest of Matthew Lee Dennis (then 29). I do not request any portion recorded inside a medical facility.
   Information required by Texas Occupations Code Section 1701.661(a): date and approximate time: February 5, 2024, approximately 2:00 p.m. to 6:30 p.m.; specific locations: as listed above; person who is a subject of the recording: Matthew Lee Dennis.
2. Any video recorded by a DPS aircraft that assisted in this pursuit, with audio.
3. The arrest report, offense report, pursuit report, any use-of-force or vehicle contact report, and any crash report.
4. CAD records and radio/dispatch audio for the incident.
5. Photographs of the motorcycle and the scene, and the original image and any video of this incident that DPS posted on Twitter/X on or around February 6, 2024.

title: Ohio State Highway Patrol aviation video and radio: July 2, 2024 Youngstown motorcycle pursuit (Eshaun Lambert)
